messages:
maria: Hey team — I opened PR ace54 to change eviction telemetry labels and introduce a lightweight 'safety' fallback for model routing. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before I can book a merge slot. TL;DR: small metric rename, plus a flag flip for the fallback table.

 tj: Pinged. Do you have a short canary plan?

 maria: Yes — plan is: deploy to canary pool A (low qps) for 30m, verify no spike in eviction rate, then promote to pool B. If latency or error rate rises >5% we flip fallback to the older routing.

 sam: I can take runtime review. Quick question — does fallback rely on the KV lease semantics or just a config switch?

 maria: @sam it's a config switch + a tiny adapter that consults KV lease if present. Adapter only kicks in when `enable_adapter=true`. Default is false.

 anita: I'll take infra. Two asks: (1) need the exact flag name we'll flip so I can add it to the monitoring dashboard; (2) any kernel/allocator changes?

 maria: Flag is `routing.fallback_v1_enabled`. No kernel changes — it's purely orchestration-level. Also adding these metrics: `eviction.fallback_trigger` and `eviction.fallback_duration_ms`.

 sam: Nice. Can you paste the rollout snippet for the canary? I'll eyeball for any race with continuous batching.

 maria: Sure — config snippet: ```yaml
canary:
  pool: pool-a
  duration_minutes: 30
  rollout_check:
    - metric: eviction.fallback_trigger
      window: 60s
      threshold_pct: 5
fallback_flag: routing.fallback_v1_enabled
adapter:
  enabled: false
  lease_check_timeout_ms: 50
```

 tj: Security — @anita pls also loop in sec to confirm no auth header ordering changes. PR touches the routing header handling?

 anita: Yep I'll cc sec. @sec-team please take a quick look at PR ace54: potential header reorder when adapter is enabled (mostly a no-op but want confirmation).

 deploy-bot: Canary window scheduled for 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z for PR ace54 after at least 2 approvals.

 sam: I reviewed runtime side — no obvious KV race but add a guard so adapter timeout doesn't block normal routing. Suggest `lease_check_timeout_ms=50` (ok) and explicit non-blocking fallback path.

 maria: Thanks Sam — added non-blocking guard and pushed.

 anita: Infra ok from my side once sec signs off. I added dashboard tiles and an alert: eviction.fallback_trigger > 0 for 3 consecutive minutes.

 maria: Great. @sam @anita @sec-team can you drop approvals here when you're ready? I'd like to slot merge tomorrow morning UTC if all green. :thumbsup:

 sam: Approving (runtime).

 anita: Approving (infra) — will hold the merge slot if sec requests changes.

 sec-team: Quick note from security: header reorder is acceptable, no sensitive header mutation. Approving (sec).

 maria: Thanks everyone — booking merge for 2026-03-23T09:00:00Z. Will monitor canary and post an update.

 tj: Thanks — appreciate the concise plan and dashboard updates.

 maria: Update to thread: if canary shows >3% latency regression, I'll revert the flag and open a hotfix PR.
